# Validation scope and local commands

Legal/entity, authorization, mutation and evidence contracts stay automatic. Portable conformance owns portable-manifest, static parity, meeting collaboration and durable draft contracts on Node 24. Standalone manual workflows retain their own copies. A mapped Calendar page change or documentation/style change uses five critical routes across all eight workspaces; shared, unmapped or legal/entity changes, main and manual runs use the complete route sweep. Corporation and desktop flows remain.

## Local entry points

```sh
npm ci
npm run test:legal
npm run test:portable-manifest
npm run test:interaction-audit
# Full browser coverage (install Chromium first):
npm run test:entity-sweep
```

Feature branches without an open PR use local commands. A local pass does not replace validation of the submitted revision. Main/release publication keeps the workflow's existing authorization and artifact conditions.

CI optimization batch: November 7, 2026. Workflow syntax and focused orchestration/selection checks are separate from complete application, native-platform and research validation.
